name: Lance
source:
Lance is a loner average student at school but, secretly, he is a Paramedium Cleric at night. He has a grudge against popular students except for Nina, another Paramedium Cleric who works in the same guild as him.

[Edited from [url=https://www.castingcall.club/projects/paramedium-a-noise-in-the-attic]Casting Call Club[/url]]
